413:t_1:86.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Meet me at the temple in two hours...」

413:t_1:90.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I... was absorbed into this fleet, but I've grown thoroughly sick of their methods.」

413:t_1:91.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're the great pirate $$ラケージ$$!」

413:t_1:92.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「That's right. $$ピニオン$$ of the $$霧の海$$... No, $$ピニオン$$ of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

413:t_1:93.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You know who I am?」

413:t_1:94.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I've done a fair bit of information gathering.」

413:t_1:95.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You... about what you said before... Are you going to fight these guys...?」

413:t_1:96.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Yes... I'm going back to piracy, after having this fleet sink.」

413:t_1:98.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You're... vulgar, but you show promise. I wouldn't mind letting you join my crew.」

413:t_1:99.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Who'd want to help a pirate?!」

413:t_1:100.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Even if this fleet's attack target is $$ガルガンティア$$?」

413:t_1:103.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Yes... My information is reliable.」

413:t_1:104.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They're going to... attack $$ガルガンティア$$...」

413:t_1:110.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have completed analysis of the virus afflicting Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$, using data provided by $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$.」

413:t_1:111.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will perform a physical examination of Ensign $$レド$$.」

413:t_1:113.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...The examination is complete. No abnormalities were detected.」

413:t_1:114.en:
$$レド$$
「...So he's commanded this huge fleet from this cramped space all this time... I couldn't do that.」

413:t_1:115.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s seclusion in his cockpit makes him a symbol and inspires awe in the fleet members...」

413:t_1:116.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As a result, I believe it functions to produce strong leadership.」

413:t_1:117.en:
$$レド$$
「So he's scarier when they can't see him... But is it right to frighten people like that?」

413:t_1:118.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Dealing with fear is a basic principle of biological behavior. A display of power terrifies opponents, but brings peace to those who submit.」

413:t_1:120.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you saying throwing those fleet members into the sea like we saw earlier is part of that, too?」

413:t_1:122.en:
$$レド$$
「Even so... taking people's lives like that...」

413:t_1:123.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I conclude that improving leadership efficiency through displays of power is effective as a countermeasure against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

413:t_1:124.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It mobilizes many personnel and helps maintain a strong, highly functional community. Furthermore...」

413:t_1:126.en:
$$レド$$
「...Maybe... I should never have gotten out of here, either...」

413:t_1:127.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「There is an incoming transmission from Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$.」

413:t_1:129.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Did you get some sleep, $$レド$$?」

413:t_1:131.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「We'll begin enlightening the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ tomorrow. Information from your $$チェインバー#pilot$$ has also given us a plan for dealing with the unit called $c.」

413:t_1:132.en:
$$レド$$
「...Sir, could you call off the attack on $$ガルガンティア$$?」

413:t_1:135.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「You sympathize with them... Doesn't that mean we should enlighten them as soon as possible?」

413:t_1:137.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「They are excellent personnel and resources for expanding the domain of human prosperity.」

413:t_1:139.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「$$レド$$... Our mission is to bring a new order to this planet.」

413:t_1:140.en:
$$レド$$
「Then it's no different from the $$銀河同盟$$...」

413:t_1:141.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「If we can't return to the front lines, we'll make this Earth our paradise, a second $$アヴァロン$$.」

413:t_1:142.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our justice has not changed. Don't hesitate.」

413:t_1:143.en:
$$レド$$
(I came here to protect everyone from the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. To protect $$エイミー$$, $$ベベル$$, and those people, I...)

413:t_1:144.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have received orders from Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$: 'Ensign $$レド$$, assume combat readiness and enter my combat command.'」

413:t_1:145.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request your decision.」

413:t_1:146.en:
$$レド$$
「My decision... I decide, and you carry it out. It's always been that way...」

413:t_1:147.en:
$$レド$$
「But I... may never have really chosen anything even once.」

413:t_1:148.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I do not understand your statement. Regarding the Lieutenant Colonel's order...」

413:t_1:149.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... How much fighting strength does this fleet have?」

413:t_1:150.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I do not know.」

413:t_1:152.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Based on Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s statements, I estimate its fighting strength is comparable to $c's.」

413:t_1:153.en:
$$レド$$
「How does your fighting strength compare to $$ストライカー#robot$$'s?」

413:t_1:154.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot calculate it due to insufficient data. I cannot understand the intent of your question.」

413:t_1:155.en:
$$レド$$
「Can you fight $$ストライカー#robot$$?」

413:t_1:158.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$ is currently carrying out actions outside the scope of Alliance military duty. It can be designated a combat target.」

413:t_1:159.en:
$$レド$$
「I see. Then... Can I fight the Lieutenant Colonel? $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

413:t_1:160.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Answering that question exceeds my functions as a Support and Enlightenment System.」

413:t_1:161.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Formulation of combat policy is entrusted to you in all circumstances.」

413:t_1:163.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have detected a human approaching me. It is $$ピニオン$$.」

413:t_1:166.en:
$$レド$$
「...I need to talk to you, $$ピニオン$$.」

413:t_1:167.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I need to talk to you too, $$レド$$.」
